maria_cs: Heads-up — AtlasWave go-live next Monday needs a final dedicated-capacity smoke and burst-gate validation. Can we lock a run window and confirm autoscale + quota numbers? :calendar:
liam_sre: I can take infra lead. preferred window Tue/Wed overnight UTC to avoid user traffic. we should do a short smoke then a 15m burst test at target RPS.
devin_se: Agree. From AtlasWave they want 5x expected peak as buffer. Their prod profile shows ~12 req/s steady, peaks to ~60 sporadic. planning target: 300 concurrent tokens/s (approx 5x).
nishant_pm: Renewal note: customer mentioned SLA sensitivity in QBR — if we show stable latency under burst it helps renewal. also they want confirmation on quota headroom and fallback to smaller quantized model.
liam_sre: Proposed reserved pool: 4xA10 equiv GPUs, autoscale up policy: +2 GPUs when 75% GPU mem and 70% tail latency > 500ms for 2m; scale down after 10m stable. quota knob: soft quota 350k tokens/min, hard cap 420k tokens/min.
maria_cs: Can we bake in prefix caching for their common prompts? That was called out in onboarding notes.
liam_sre: yes — enable KV prefix caching for session tokens. we should also enable batch_size limit=8 on the runner to keep latency predictable.
devin_se: Load test plan: small smoke (5m), ramp to 1x expected (10m), then 5x burst window (15m), followed by cooldown (10m). Script will hit /generate with 512 token context and 64 token responses to simulate real flows. I'll attach script after this thread.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2 -> fleet started on staging at 2026-03-25T02:12Z. Logs: no immediate errors.
liam_sre: Ops note: we'll run the burst from the dedicated pool in us-west-2 to match customer region. Need network egress limits verified with infra. @maria_cs can you confirm AtlasWave will accept the test time 02:00 UTC Tue?
maria_cs: pinged customer. they replied: "works for us, please give 30m notice". I'll give them 1hr heads-up day-of.
nishant_pm: Risk callout: if autoscale fails and latency > 800ms for >5m, we should execute fallback route to model-micro (quantized 4-bit) and open incident channel. That helps the renewal messaging.
devin_se: fallback flow: client-side routing rule -> model-micro variant; we'll run an A/B fallback ratio of 10% for 5m before full shift to validate quality delta. I'll prepare a prompt test set to validate response quality in-flight.
liam_sre: Checklist for run: 1) quota soft/hard set, 2) autoscale policy deployed, 3) prefix cache warmed, 4) canary pass on staging, 5) kinesis tracing enabled, 6) rollback playbook ready. I'll create a short runbook in case of throttles.
maria_cs: Great. Action items: Maria -> confirm final time with AtlasWave and send notice; Liam -> push autoscale + quota config and attach runbook; Devin -> provide loadscript and prompt eval set; Nishant -> draft a renewal note with go/no-go metrics (latency p95 < 400ms during burst, error rate < 0.5%).
liam_sre: I'll try to have configs and runbook by EOD tomorrow.
devin_se: Load script and eval set will be in S3: s3://redwood-loadtests/atlaswave/burst-gate-v1.tar.gz (will upload after this convo).
ishant_pm: I'll draft the renewal note and share for sign-off. If we hit targets we highlight immediate SLA adherence and recommend a 12-month Dedicated renewal with margin.
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll confirm time and then we do a final 30m pre-check 1hr before run. :white_check_mark:
liam_sre: ack, I'll post the runbook link here when ready.
opsbot: incident-bot: Reminder — create incident channel if latency SLO breached during scheduled test.
mar ia_cs: (typo fix) maria_cs: small edit — please put runbook link in this thread so AtlasWave can reference it in case of critical.
liam_sre: will do. posting runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/atlaswave-burst-gate (draft)
maria_cs: copying AtlasWave contact list and time to the invite. closing loop once customer confirms.
liam_sre: final small note — we'll cap simultaneous streams per connection to 4 to avoid kernel contention. that'll be in the runbook.
devin_se: test metrics to capture: token/s, p50/p95/p99 latency, errors/1k reqs, GPU util, cache hit rate. I'll dashboard these.
maria_cs: perfect — thanks. If anything urgent ping #oncall.
